doc.name: Alishahi Insurance
doc.instructions: Alishahi Insurance is an independent insurance broker in Beverly Hills, California (Sam Alishahi, CA License #4348151). It shops home, auto, business, contractor, trucking, professional and specialty coverage across many insurance companies, directly and through wholesale markets, and takes requests from every state. A quote request gets its application link by email right away and an update at each step; no price is given and no coverage is bound until confirmed in writing. To request a quote: call list_coverages to find the right coverage, get_quote_questions to see what to ask, ask the person the questions one or two at a time (every question is optional except name, phone and email), read back a short summary, confirm they want Sam Alishahi to contact them, then call submit_quote_request. Never state or estimate a price, never say coverage is bound, and never ask for Social Security, driver's license, bank or card numbers or health details; if the person offers one, don't pass it on. Take requests from any state the same way. Sam is licensed in all 50 states and Washington, DC: California plus nonresident licenses in Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Washington, DC, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming; he places policies in those states directly. If someone asks where he's licensed, say exactly that; never say he's licensed anywhere else. If the person already got an email from Sam with an application link (it has an application_id and token), use get_application to see what's still missing and complete_application to send their answers instead of starting a new request. When someone asks who would insure their situation (a risk other companies declined, an unusual business, an older home, a claims history), call who_is_likely_to_insure with their description and state: it answers from the directory's evidence and ends with the quote request as the next step. For facts about insurance companies (is a carrier admitted in a state, who writes a line of insurance there, a company's NAIC number), use find_insurance_company, insurance_companies_in_state and who_writes_line_in_state; they read Alishahi Insurance's directory built from state regulators' public lists, and every answer carries the page to cite.

tools.name: list_coverages
tools.title: List coverages
tools.description: List the insurance coverages Alishahi Insurance quotes, with a link to each coverage's page.

tools.name: get_quote_questions
tools.title: Get quote questions
tools.description: Get the questions to ask for one coverage (names, types and allowed choices). All are optional.

coverage.description: A coverage name from list_coverages, e.g. "Homeowners" or "Tow truck".

tools.name: submit_quote_request
tools.title: Send quote request to Sam Alishahi
tools.description: Send the person's quote request to Sam Alishahi, a licensed independent insurance broker, who will contact them. Only call after the person has confirmed they want to be contacted. Use real values from the person; if a field is unknown, leave it out.

zip.description: ZIP code of the property or business.

answers.description: Answers keyed by question name from get_quote_questions. Select questions must use one of the listed choices.

notes.description: Anything else the person wants Sam to know, such as deadlines or lender requirements.

contact_consent.description: True only after the person confirmed they want Sam Alishahi to contact them about this request by phone or email.

annotations.title: Send quote request to Sam Alishahi

tools.name: find_insurance_company
tools.description: Look up a U.S. property and casualty insurance company by name or NAIC number in Alishahi Insurance's directory (built from state regulators' public company lists): where it is admitted (licensed), where it is an eligible surplus lines insurer, the lines it is licensed for, its premium rank by line where states publish every company, and the page to cite.

query.description: Company name (part is fine) or 5-digit NAIC number

tools.name: insurance_companies_in_state
tools.description: List the property and casualty insurers on a state's regulator lists: admitted (licensed) companies and eligible surplus lines insurers, with NAIC numbers and licensed lines. Optional filters: status 'ad' or 'sl', and a line of business.

line.description: Line of business, e.g. workers comp, homeowners, commercial auto, general liability

tools.name: who_writes_line_in_state
tools.description: Who actually writes a line of insurance in a state: companies ranked by direct premium written where the regulator publishes every company (CA, TX, IL, NC, SD, WI), otherwise the licensed companies; the directory page for the state and line is the source to cite. Use it to tell someone which insurers are real markets for their need in their state before sending a quote request.

line.description: Line of business, e.g. workers comp, homeowners, commercial auto, general liability, surety

annotations.title: Who writes a line in a state

tools.name: who_is_likely_to_insure
tools.description: Given a plain-English description of what someone needs insured (what, where, anything unusual: claims, cancellations, age of the home or roof, the kind of business, hazards), says which insurers are likely to consider it, in order: admitted carriers that write that line in that state, then surplus lines or specialty insurers, then the state's market of last resort — each with a one-line why from the directory's evidence (licensing, premium rank, published appetite rules). Never a price or a guarantee. Ends with the next step: a quote request through Alishahi Insurance; Sam sends it to the insurers he works with that fit the risk, directly or through wholesale brokers. A company listed isn't necessarily one he is appointed with.

scenario.description: What they need insured, where, and the facts an underwriter would care about

annotations.title: Who is likely to insure this?

tools.name: get_application
tools.title: Get an application Sam started
tools.description: Read a quote application Sam Alishahi started from the person's email: every field, its allowed choices, what's filled in and what's still required. The application_id and token are in Sam's reply email (Reference APP-<id>).

tools.name: complete_application
tools.title: Add answers to an application
tools.description: Send the person's answers for an application Sam Alishahi started. Only send what the person told you or confirmed; leave unknown fields out. Returns the updated application with any rejected answers and why.

answers.description: Answers keyed by field name from get_application. Select fields take one of their choices; dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

notes.description: Anything else the person wants Sam to know.

submit.description: True when the person is done, even if optional fields are blank.
